title: Build catalog entries
responsibility: Turns active units and plans into catalog entries, marks owned file changes, and excludes pages that only load data from the visible list.

inputs.name: catalogUnit.unit
inputs.description: The unit manifest: its id, kind, status, title, responsibility, owned source files, and optional helperContracts and recorded preview. Only an active unit with a catalog category yields an entry; a retired unit, or one whose kind has no catalog category (platforms and types count as none), yields null.

examples.title: Report detail
examples.responsibility: Loads one report for the report detail page.

inputs.name: catalogUnit.changed
inputs.description: The changed file paths to compare with the unit's owned files. A change counts when it equals an owned path or starts with an owned path followed by '/', and paths are compared exactly as supplied.

inputs.name: catalogListed.units
inputs.description: The unit manifests of the revision being listed. A unit of kind page that owns at least one file, where every owned file is named +page.js, +page.ts, +page.server.js or +page.server.ts, is loader-only and its id is removed from the items.

examples.title: Report detail
examples.responsibility: Loads one report for the report detail page.

examples.title: Harness view
examples.responsibility: Renders the harness view named by the route parameter.

inputs.name: catalogListed.items
inputs.description: The catalog entries to filter, kept in their order. An entry whose id belongs to a loader-only page is removed; a non-planned function entry is retitled with one name(input, ...) line per helper contract that is pure and has at least two distinct consumers (each input shown by its last dotted segment), and is removed when no helper contract qualifies.

examples.summary: Loads one report for the report detail page.

examples.summary: Renders the harness view named by the route parameter.

inputs.name: planCatalog.plan
inputs.description: The plan record for one unit: its goal, lifecycle and thread count appear on the entry, and its path is compared with the changed paths. The last item of versions is the latest version, and its first image supplies the thumbnail when one exists.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.goal: Plans a grid of evidence cards.

versions.prompt: Design a grid of evidence cards with a filter bar.

inputs.name: planCatalog.unit
inputs.description: An existing catalog entry to enrich, or null to build a planned draft from the plan's id, category, title, goal and lifecycle (its kind is the category without its final s). An existing entry keeps its id, category, kind, title, planned flag, verification and verification note, and an existing changed mark is retained.

examples.title: Evidence grid
examples.summary: Plans a grid of evidence cards.
examples.verificationNote: This is a plan. Approval does not verify running behavior.

inputs.name: planCatalog.changed
inputs.description: The changed file paths to check against the plan path. The plan is marked changed when its path equals a changed path or a changed path starts with the plan path followed by '/', and an existing changed mark is retained.

outputs.name: catalogUnit
outputs.description: The catalog entry for an active unit that has a catalog category, or null otherwise; pages take the unit title, other categories take the explorer name, and the entry starts with unknown verification, no plan, no versions and zero threads. Its thumbnail is a recorded thumbnail for pages and layouts even without a preview, one for components only when a preview is given, and null for every other category.

examples.summary: Loads one report for the report detail page.
examples.verificationNote: No complete verification for this entity at this commit has been loaded.

examples.title: Harness view
examples.summary: Renders the harness view named by the route parameter.
examples.verificationNote: No complete verification for this entity at this commit has been loaded.

outputs.name: catalogListed
outputs.description: A new list of the items in their original order, without the entries of loader-only pages, with non-planned function entries retitled from their qualifying helper contracts and dropped when none qualifies. The supplied entries and unit manifests are not changed; a retitled entry is a copy.

examples.title: Harness view
examples.summary: Renders the harness view named by the route parameter.
examples.verificationNote: No complete verification for this entity at this commit has been loaded.

outputs.name: planCatalog
outputs.description: The base entry (the supplied one, or a planned draft when none is) with the plan goal as its summary, the plan lifecycle and thread count, hasPlan set to true, latestVersion set to the latest version, and approvedVersion set to it only when its approval is current. A thumbnail from the latest version's first image takes priority; otherwise the base thumbnail is kept (null for a planned draft), and verification is left as the base entry has it.
